input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 fully meets our preferred insurance position: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (imposed unconditionally, i.e. broader than our conditional "where Vendor processes Customer Data" formulation), all maintained through the term plus one year, with employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 as an extra. Section 18.2 provides certificates of insurance on request, and adds insurer quality, primacy, cancellation notice and non-limitation of liability protections in our favour. No redline required.
